answer: An answer's reward is multiplied by min(1, d/5), where d is the number of distinct funding-independent clusters whose members attested it. A self-attestation is an echo and scores zero diversity, so a farm of 200 aliases all wired to one funding root is a closed haven that emits only echoes: d stays near 1 and its reward collapses to 20% no matter how many identities sign. Real standing is the rare pearl of five unrelated clusters independently vouching, which one operator cannot fake by minting more names.
